{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module SearchIndex where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, diffUTCTime)
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout)

type IndexId = ByteString
type EncryptedDoc = ByteString
type IV = ByteString

data StorageEntry = StorageEntry
  { entryIV       :: IV
  , entryCipher   :: EncryptedDoc
  , entryChecksum :: Word8
  } deriving (Show)

data SearchIndex = SearchIndex
  { indexStore    :: IORef (Map.Map IndexId StorageEntry)
  , indexKey      :: ByteString
  , blockSize     :: Int
  }

data DecryptResult
  = DecryptOK ByteString
  | DecryptFailure
  deriving (Show, Eq)

-- | Initialize a new search index with a 16-byte key
-- The key length is validated to match the required block size so that
-- decryptCBC (which derives its block size from the key) stays consistent
-- with validatePKCS7 (which uses blockSize). A mismatched key length would
-- otherwise produce malformed decryption behavior.
newSearchIndex :: ByteString -> IO SearchIndex
newSearchIndex key = do
  let requiredKeyLen = 16
  when (BS.length key /= requiredKeyLen) $
    ioError (userError "newSearchIndex: key must be exactly 16 bytes")
  ref <- newIORef Map.empty
  return $ SearchIndex ref key requiredKeyLen

-- | PKCS7 padding validation
validatePKCS7 :: Int -> ByteString -> Bool
validatePKCS7 bsize plaintext
  | BS.null plaintext = False
  | otherwise =
      let padByte = BS.last plaintext
          padLen  = fromIntegral padByte
          len     = BS.length plaintext
      in padLen >= 1 && padLen <= bsize &&
         padLen <= len &&
         BS.all (== padByte) (BS.drop (len - padLen) plaintext)

-- | Strip PKCS7 padding after validation
stripPKCS7 :: ByteString -> ByteString
stripPKCS7 bs =
  let padLen = fromIntegral (BS.last bs)
  in BS.take (BS.length bs - padLen) bs

-- | Simple CBC decryption (using XOR with key as block cipher stand-in)
-- In production this would use AES, but structure is identical
decryptCBC :: ByteString -> IV -> ByteString -> ByteString
decryptCBC key iv ciphertext =
  let bsize = BS.length key
      blocks = chunksOf bsize ciphertext
      prevs  = iv : blocks
  in BS.concat $ zipWith (\prev ct ->
       let decrypted = xorBytes key ct
       in xorBytes prev decrypted
     ) prevs blocks

xorBytes :: ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString
xorBytes a b = BS.pack $ BS.zipWith xor a b

chunksOf :: Int -> ByteString -> [ByteString]
chunksOf n bs
  | BS.null bs = []
  | otherwise  = let (h, t) = BS.splitAt n bs in h : chunksOf n t

-- | Core decryption routine for stored documents
-- Returns a single unified error for any decryption failure
decryptEntry :: SearchIndex -> StorageEntry -> DecryptResult
decryptEntry idx entry =
  let plaintext = decryptCBC (indexKey idx) (entryIV entry) (entryCipher entry)
      bsize     = blockSize idx
  in if not (validatePKCS7 bsize plaintext)
     then DecryptFailure
     else
       let stripped = stripPKCS7 plaintext
           computed = BS.foldl' xor 0 stripped
       in if computed /= entryChecksum entry
          then DecryptFailure
          else DecryptOK stripped

-- | Store an encrypted document in the index
storeDocument :: SearchIndex -> IndexId -> IV -> EncryptedDoc -> Word8 -> IO ()
storeDocument idx docId iv cipher chk = do
  let entry = StorageEntry iv cipher chk
  modifyIORef' (indexStore idx) (Map.insert docId entry)

-- | Search query: attempts to decrypt and match against a term
-- Returns a single generic error message for any decryption failure
queryIndex :: SearchIndex -> IndexId -> ByteString -> IO (Either String Bool)
queryIndex idx docId searchTerm = do
  store <- readIORef (indexStore idx)
  case Map.lookup docId store of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "not_found"
    Just entry ->
      case decryptEntry idx entry of
        DecryptFailure -> return $ Left "decrypt_error"
        DecryptOK plain -> return $ Right (searchTerm `BS.isInfixOf` plain)

-- | Batch query endpoint - processes multiple document lookups
batchQuery :: SearchIndex -> [(IndexId, ByteString)] -> IO [Either String Bool]
batchQuery idx queries = mapM (\(docId, term) -> queryIndex idx docId term) queries

-- | Health check that only reveals whether documents are accessible
healthCheck :: SearchIndex -> IO (Map.Map IndexId String)
healthCheck idx = do
  store <- readIORef (indexStore idx)
  let check entry = case decryptEntry idx entry of
        DecryptFailure -> "unavailable"
        DecryptOK _    -> "ok"
  return $ Map.map check store
